name: Les Borges Blanques (Spain)
description: The four red bars of Aragon on yellow at the hoist charged with a white bull, and a green fly third charged with a white fleur-de-lis between four smaller ones.
history: Municipal flag of Les Borges Blanques; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four red pales on the yellow hoist part
fleur-de-lis surrounded by four smaller fleurs-de-lis
